name: Black Incense
source:
London, present day.

A city of glass and shadow, of secret orders and shifting loyalties. Beneath its polished surface lies another world, one of whispered rites, hidden societies, and ancient appetites disguised as modern ambition.

You play as a 19-year-old university student whose life begins to fracture after a chance encounter pulls her into this network of power, lust, and secrecy. From there, Black Incense becomes whatever you make of it: an espionage thriller, an occult mystery, a descent into temptation, or a rise to mastery.

Every choice shapes not just her fate, but the forces surrounding her. You decide who she trusts, who she betrays, what she desires, and what she’s willing to lose.

Each decision opens new paths, closes others, and alters the course of the story in ways both subtle and irreversible.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/BlackIncense]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
伦敦，现在。

一座充满玻璃和阴影、秘密命令和不断变化的忠诚的城市。在其光洁的表面之下隐藏着另一个世界，其中有低声的仪式、隐秘的社会和伪装成现代野心的古老欲望。

你扮演一名19岁的大学生，一次偶然的遭遇将她卷入了这个权力、欲望和秘密的网络，她的生活开始破裂。从那时起，《黑香》就变成了无论你怎么理解它：一部间谍惊悚片、一部神秘小说、陷入诱惑，或者上升到掌握。

每一个选择不仅决定了她的命运，也决定了她周围的力量。你决定她信任谁，背叛谁，她渴望什么，以及她愿意失去什么。

每个决定都会开辟新的道路，关闭其他的道路，并以微妙且不可逆转的方式改变故事的进程。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/BlackIncense]Patreon[/url]]
